text:
incident-bot: paging sasha_oncall for GPU node instability: recent cluster alerts show repeated Xid 13/71 resets and container crashes on node gnode-78. High ECC correctable counts reported. ~2x increase in pod restarts in last 10m

sasha_oncall: acked. jumping in — handing to infra triage. what’s the immediate customer impact? :eyes:

customer-success: seeing retries and transient 5xx for inference requests from org AcmeAI — approx 4% error rate over last 8m. A few customers reported slow responses too.

mike_infra: quick summary from gnode-78: kernel logs show repeated `NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 31`
kubectl top node gnode-78 shows GPU mem spikes then OOM on containers, several pods OOMKilled (exit 137).

irene_sre: can we avoid full evacuation? prefer cordon + selective drain for noisy GPUs. need nv-host and dmesg dumps first.

mike_infra: running collector now — grabbing:
```
journalctl -k -u nvidia-driver --since "10 minutes ago" > /tmp/gn78-nvlog.txt
nvidia-smi -q -d ECC,MEMORY > /tmp/gn78-nvsmi.txt
kubectl get pods -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=gnode-78 > /tmp/gn78-pods.txt
```
Will upload in 2m.

opsbot: automated action: alerted by gpu-health-monitor — node gnode-78 flagged as noisy. Suggested action: `cordon` if no immediate mitigations applied in 5 minutes.

ben_platform: if ECC correctables are climbing fast (>100/min) we should retire the GPU early. do we have retire counts? check `nvidia-smi -q -d RETIRED`

mike_infra: posted snippets: `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC` shows correctable errors incrementing on GPU0 and GPU1, retire count still 0 but page retire events starting. dmesg shows `GPU: page retire threshold exceeded` messages.

carol_prodeng: timeline note: host-side inference tasks saw tail-latency spikes coincident with resets. Recommend rerouting traffic for critical customers while we investigate.

sasha_oncall: plan: 1) remove non-critical pods from GPUs on gnode-78 2) collect full nv-host/core dumps 3) if resets continue, cordon+evac 4) open infra escalation to vendor (driver team). I'm starting the drain for low-priority workloads now.

irene_sre: when you drain, use `--ignore-daemonsets --grace-period=30 --timeout=5m` for best-effort — we want to avoid long waits. Also add env var to inference pods to retry once on 5xx.

mike_infra: executing selective drain: `kubectl drain gnode-78 --selector=priority!=critical --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force` — evicting 12 pods.

customer-success: notifying AcmeAI about degraded performance and that we’re actively mitigating. Keeping them on the loop.

mike_infra: extra telemetry: `nvidia-smi pmon -c 1` shows high power spikes preceding Xid events. Could be thermal or kernel/driver race. Fan speeds nominal.

ben_platform: on compute config side, toggle temporary fallback routing: sending new inference sessions for tiered customers to dedicated-pool-B to reduce impact. Doing rollout now.

sasha_oncall: confirm after drain — GPU counters still creeping?

mike_infra: after eviction, node still shows 1-2 resets in 5m. Collecting full `kasan`/oops logs and core. Attaching encrypted bundle to incident.

opsbot: automated note: created incident ticket INF-2026-6123 and assigned to infra-driver-team.

irene_sre: we should also capture probe: `echo 1 > /sys/module/nvidia/parameters/enable_page_retire` (only if vendor recommends). Don’t run unless driver team ok.

ben_platform: vendor escalation recommended. include `nvidia-bug-report.sh` output and `kconfig` and kernel version. Also list full container memory limits, cgroup OOM killer events.

sasha_oncall: attaching to the incident bridge in 5m for handoff — if driver team suggests immediate node reboot we’ll schedule with minimal customer impact windows.

carol_prodeng: can we run a temporary shader/compute scheduler throttle to avoid bursty workloads? reduce batch size to 0.8x for hosted inference for next 30m.

mike_infra: reduced batch size for affected route, rolled config to edge. Observed 30% drop in peak memory and fewer OOMs so far.

customer-success: AcmeAI acknowledged, appreciate the proactive routing. No escalation yet.

irene_sre: next steps: vendor root-cause analysis; if driver patch not available, plan: cordon node for maintenance, replace GPU if retire counts increase, or schedule rolling host reboots with kernel-driver rollback test.

sasha_oncall: handing to night infra lead in 15m: irene_sre will take over. leaving notes in incident ticket. :white_check_mark:

irene_sre: taking over. will follow up with vendor update and postmortem draft once we have full logs.

incident-bot: incident status changed to `mitigating` — reduced customer impact via routing and selective drain. Next update in 30m or on new driver insight.
